title: cdk-construct-s3-website examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples in packages/cdk-construct-s3-website/examples/.

Scenarios:
- minimal/ — required acmCertificateArn only (from bridge fixture hostedZones.certificate_arn)
- comprehensive/ — WAF, CloudFront logging, custom error responses, CORS, geo restriction, function associations
- with-dns/ — parentZoneId + parentZoneName from bridge fixture (divergent: adds Route53 record)

All 5 languages. Assertion tests in test/s3-website-examples.test.ts.
